about_the_game:
The World's Goodest Pup demo is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder where you perform in dog shows! Collect new tricks, decorate your pet resort, unlock breeds, and accessorize at shops as you make your way to the top dog podium. Fluffy, heartwarming runs await!

In this demo, you can start building your pet resort and complete a single run with your first dog, a lovable Golden Retriever. The full game will have many more playable breeds and randomly generated runs.

Wag and bark your way into the world of dog shows, where strategy, charm, and a little bit of luck are your keys to victory. Start by choosing your companion from a variety of breeds, each with their own unique traits and potential. Through strategic deck-building, you'll train your dog in obedience, agility, and style.

Build and customize your pet resort. As you collect new buildings and aesthetic items, you can arrange to best suit your tastes.

As you travel through the city, from small dog park to stadium, assemble different builds to tackle unique situations. Each stage is a chance for you and your pup to level up.

World's Goodest Pup is designed to be a relaxing and positive experience, making it perfect for animal lovers of all ages. Dive into a beautifully crafted world where the competition is friendly, and the focus is on the joy and camaraderie of dog shows.

Features:

  • Single Play Though: In this demo, enjoy a single run of the game

  • Golden Retriever Run: For the demo, play through competitions with your golden pup

  • Design Your Pet Resort: Decorate and arrange your dream paradise for your fluffy friends

  • Artifacts, items, and cards galore: Combine different strategies to adapt to your dog's situation

  • Wholesome Content: A cozy game experience focused on the love of animals
